Verdict

Reviewed 27 Oct 2026 · next 25 Jan 2027

Optional markdown renderer built on react-markdown 10.1. Adopt only if formatted assistant output is needed: it adds about 87 packages and 72 KB gzip. Raw HTML is off by default, so the XSS surface is react-markdown's standard one.

Current Requirement: In-app AI assistant chat interface (React)

Reasoning

  1. Wraps react-markdown 10.1 and does not enable rehype-raw or dangerous HTML in its published code.
  2. Adds 87 packages to the tree and about 72 KB gzip on top of the core bundle.
  3. Published through the same OIDC pipeline; 118 of 119 versions carry provenance.
  4. The suite offers react-streamdown (Shiki, KaTeX, Mermaid) and react-syntax-highlighter for other rendering needs.

Caveats

  • Any plugin that enables raw HTML (rehype-raw) reintroduces XSS risk; keep the default configuration.
  • Markdown parsing runs on every streamed token, so memoise or throttle if messages are long.
  • 0.x and ESM-only.

Decision context

Approved

@assistant-ui/react is the primary choice for In-app AI assistant chat interface (React). This package is classified as Adopted.

Adopt @assistant-ui/react as the single direct dependency, plus @assistant-ui/react-markdown only if formatted assistant output is required. @assistant-ui/core, @assistant-ui/tap and @assistant-ui/store arrive transitively and must be allowlisted because they are required peers, not optional extras; @assistant-ui/store was missing from the original four-package list. All five are MIT, provenance-signed, free of install scripts and advisories, and the repository publishes through OIDC trusted publishing with a protected environment. The residual risks are footprint (63 MB full install, about 135 KB gzip) and 0.x churn (roughly 30 releases per quarter), so pin exact versions, import only from @assistant-ui/react, keep rehype-raw disabled, and re-review on the 90-day cadence.
